units.source_text: 室中弥漫着不知从哪里飘来的香烟。

en.t: The room was filled with fragrant smoke that had drifted in from some unknown place.

units.source_text: 诸女群集，钗钿错杂，裙影蹁跹，人人举止婀娜，艳丽动人。

en.t: The ladies had gathered in numbers, their hair ornaments mingling in bright confusion and the shadows of their skirts fluttering, each one graceful in movement and strikingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 但终缺乏端详娴雅的风情，显然是热爱时髦、竞尚富丽的家风。

en.t: Yet they still lacked a composed and elegant refinement; this was plainly a household that loved fashion and competed in splendor.

units.source_text: 这些身份高贵的女子，为了观射看花，都从深闺洞房中到这门前来了。

en.t: These noble ladies had all come out from their secluded inner chambers to the front of the gate to watch the archery and view the blossoms.

units.source_text: 在这些身份高贵的女子面前，源氏公子理应恭谦谨慎，

en.t: In the presence of such high-ranking women, Prince Genji ought to have behaved with humble caution,

units.source_text: 但为目前艳丽光景所感染，兴趣顿起，

en.t: but moved by the gorgeous scene before him, his spirits suddenly rose,

units.source_text: 不由想到：“不知朦胧月下邂逅相遇的是哪一个。”

en.t: and he could not help wondering, "Which one was it that I met by chance beneath the hazy moon?"
His heart beat uneasily in his breast.

units.source_text: 他便将身靠在门旁，把催马乐《石川》加以改作，用诙谐的语调唱道：

en.t: Then he leaned against the side of the gate, adapted the saibara song "Ishikawa," and sang in a playful tone:
